utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn! Yeah, I just heard about it. Sorry I'm late—definitely want to help out. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to have you on board! Just bring whatever tools you have—hammers, paintbrushes, gloves. And a good attitude!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, we need to settle on a date and time for the repair drive. I prefer to have everything scheduled in advance.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A repair drive? When did that get organized? I thought we were just sorting tools this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I thought we had talked about it last week. We need to pin down a date—I can't stand loose ends.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm trying to figure out the exact start time too—Jules said 9am Saturday, but I need to be sure so I can fit it around my school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Jules? Are you sure about that? I haven't heard anything about a repair drive from anyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, really? Tess and Cleo were talking about it earlier too. Maybe Jules got the details mixed up, but I thought it was happening this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Bring a broken toaster, right? I'll be there around noon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: A broken toaster? Perfect, we can always use spare parts. Noon works great, I'll have the supply table set up by then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I'll see you then. Wait, is it at the community center or the park? I keep mixing those up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we don't hit any traffic or road closures—that could really eat into our gas.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Noah, I was just telling Pia about the repair drive this weekend — they're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, you didn't answer my question about the gas. Are we sure one tank is enough for all the stops?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, the repair drive is at the garage? I thought it was at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure either—let me double-check with the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, if Opal's heading to the garage, maybe I mixed things up! Let me know what you find out, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus says he's got wrenches and screws. Does that count as volunteering?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, wrenches and screws... that sounds useful! I think we're supposed to be fixing things, but I can't quite recall what day we're doing it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's this Saturday, Oren. Are you planning to bring something to fix or help out?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, I heard the repair drive is at the garage, not the community center. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Bo, it's at the garage. Gus offered some tools, and Tess was wondering about it too. I'll make sure everyone knows the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh good, thanks for confirming. I'll swing by the garage later to drop off my drill.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm heading to the garage to check on the repair drive now—want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, let me grab my list of neighbor requests—I've got a few folks from the potluck group who signed up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, let's head to the garage first to check on it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sorry, I must've mixed you up with someone else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Leo! By the way, I just wanted to confirm the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks for the update. I'll be there Sunday morning to help load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, just so you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks for the heads up. I'll see you there—let me know if you need help with anything heavy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks Rey, I might take you up on that. It's been a rough week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, you know who's heading up that repair drive? I've got a broken shelf I've been meaning to bring by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I think Mara's the one organizing it—she's been collecting tools too. I can lend you my wrench if you need to tighten anything up before you bring it in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Mara? Good to know. Thanks for the offer on the wrench—I might take you up on that if I need to fix the shelf first. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I heard you're helping with the repair drive. I've got wrenches and spare screws if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Gus, thanks! Yeah, the repair drive is this weekend — they're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops. Your wrenches and screws would be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring 'em by Saturday morning. Where should I drop 'em off?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, I heard about the repair drive. Is there anything I can do to help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet—I haven't really heard any details about the drive. Do you know when it is or what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's soon—maybe tomorrow? I heard Gus is offering tools and Vik needs help with heavy stuff.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mara, is the repair drive still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's still on! Opal's already heading to the garage — I hope that's where folks remember we're meeting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Can you give me a hand with this old generator? It's heavier than it looks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I heard you're involved in the repair drive. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry I was late. Did we already figure out who's bringing what for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane. I think we're still sorting out the details—Eli wanted a full schedule, and Oren couldn't remember the date. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira! I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive — the potluck crowd is already hyped about it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Jules—are you sure you've got the right person? I'm not involved in any repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, sorry Kira—I must've mixed you up with someone else! But hey, since you're here, would you want to join in? We could use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, keep me posted—I gotta run now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Tess said it's at the community center now? Let me double-check before you go—I thought it was still in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, I don't remember that. Better check quickly—I'm heading out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, did you hear that the repair drive is actually over at the garage now? I got that mixed up with the community center earlier!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I thought the repair drive wasn't for a few weeks? Are we doing something else this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, really? I thought it was this weekend! Let me double-check with Opal—she just headed to the garage to check on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it's 9am Saturday. Gus just offered some wrenches and screws, so we'll be well equipped.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that's perfect. I'll bring my broken shelf by then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good. See you at the community center at 9am Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're getting the whole neighborhood together to fix up the community center!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, you say? I thought it was next week... or was that the potluck? I should write this down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, it's definitely this Saturday! I can swing by and help you jot it down—want me to remind you again in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Nell, it's for small household items and electronics — folks can bring things like toasters, lamps, or bikes that need fixing. We'll have volunteers to help mend them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, I see. That sounds like a good cause. Thanks for explaining.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm glad you're both on board. Uli, bringing tools from your shed would be a huge help—thank you!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey, just waiting to hear back on the exact start time—once I know, I'll adjust my school drop-off schedule so I can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I hope we get that fixed time soon. I like to have everything set in stone so I can plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, totally—I'm in the same boat. Soon as I get a solid time, I'll let you know so we can both lock it in.
